title: Tengiz field contractor employees seek bonus clarification
reason: Worksite/private-employer grievance without demonstrated public assembly or state-policy demand.
notes: Kazinform reports 200 Senimdi Kurylys employees gathered during a break at section 42 of a Tengiz project and protested a private bonus issue. A state labor inspector joined a commission formed after the gathering, but the article does not show a public assembly or workers targeting state labor policy.

title: Planned Astana rally against draft Mass Media Law; intended site reportedly empty
reason: No actual gathering established; permit refused and Legal Media Center representatives found the intended square empty.
notes: Kursiv reports the refusal; Tirek says representatives came to the site on 18 February and found it empty. Refused plan, not an event.

title: Multiple planned independent-candidate registration protests refused permits
reason: Monitor records refused permits for planned February 11, 12 and 18 actions in multiple cities, without establishing that planned gatherings occurred.
notes: Requests concerned independent-candidate/party registration in Petropavlovsk, Almaty, Kokshetau, Astana, Pavlodar, Aktobe and West Kazakhstan. Dates vary; grouped because none is evidenced as an actual gathering in saved sources.
